what.title: 1. What PriceWise does
what.text: PriceWise helps users compare grocery prices across supermarkets and create shopping lists.

accounts.title: 2. No user accounts
accounts.text: PriceWise does not require user registration and does not create user accounts.

storage.title: 3. Shopping list storage
storage.text: Your shopping list is stored only in your browser using localStorage.

email.title: 4. Email usage
email.text: Your email is used only to send your shopping list and is not stored.

shoppingList.title: Your Shopping List
shoppingList.subtitle: Review your saved products, remove items, and send the list to yourself when needed.
shoppingList.empty: Add products from the comparison page and they will appear here.
shoppingList.emailSubtitle: Send your shopping list to your email
shoppingList.privacyNote: Your email is used only to send this shopping list to you. PriceWise does not store your email address after sending.

filters.title: Find the best prices
filters.subtitle: Filter products by supermarket and category

compare.title: Price Comparison
compare.subtitle: Compare the same product across supermarkets

footer.description: Smart grocery price comparison for shoppers in Greece. Compare prices, build your list, and save time.
footer.privacyPoint2: Your shopping list is stored only in your browser.
footer.privacyPoint3: Your email is used only when you choose to send your list.
